# Simplex Via LLC

> Practical AI adoption and custom digital products for businesses.
> The Simple Path to AI & Digital Success.

Simplex Via helps small and mid-size, owner-operated businesses find the one AI or digital
change that pays for itself, then builds it with them. Every recommendation is judged
against the **ROI Compass** — does it make you money (Effectiveness), give you hours back
(Efficiency), or make customers happier (Quality). If a recommendation cannot name the
number it moves, it does not get made.

Location: Phoenix, Arizona. Serves the Phoenix metro on both sides of the valley — Phoenix,
Scottsdale, Chandler, Gilbert, Mesa and Tempe in the East Valley; Glendale, Peoria, Surprise,
Goodyear, Avondale and Buckeye in the West Valley. Remote engagements outside that area are
accepted where the work does not require being on site.
Site: https://simplexvia.com/  Contact: https://simplexvia.com/contact.html
Phone: (480) 415-4552  Email: info@simplexvia.com

## The AI Offer Ladder — the core path

Three tiers. Each is designed to prove value before the client spends more; start free and
only move up when the numbers justify it.

1. **Free AI Value Self-Assessment** — free, about five minutes, instant results, no call
   and no obligation. Thirty questions across six areas of the business. Produces the
   client's AI Value Model: a level and score per area, from Ad Hoc to Strategic, with the
   biggest and lowest-effort opportunities highlighted.
   https://simplexvia.com/ai-results.html
2. **AI Action Plan** — flat fee. A 30-minute structured intake, then a nine-part branded
   report delivered within 48 hours: pain points, the ROI Compass opportunity map, the
   current tool stack and its cost, a four-day quick-win plan, where AI can grow revenue,
   and a dollar-quantified ROI calculation. Includes a short video walkthrough to forward
   to a partner, and a live 30-minute screen-share walkthrough.
3. **AI Concierge** — monthly retainer, done *with* the client rather than for them. Two
   45-minute live working sessions a month on an Audit → Optimize → Automate framework,
   unlimited async support with a 12-business-hour reply SLA, and every call documented.
   Deliberately limited to a small roster so delivery quality holds.

## À la carte builds — standalone projects

Scoped and quoted per project. Delivered as one-off builds, or rolled into an AI Concierge
retainer.

- **Process Optimization** — map and streamline a core workflow end to end.
- **Automation Build** — automations that remove manual, repetitive work for good.
- **Knowledge System** — a knowledge base trained on the business, its docs and its process.
- **Speed-to-Lead Agent** — an AI agent that responds to new leads before they go cold.
- **High-End Website** — a custom-designed site for businesses whose product is a changing
  list of individually-different things: inventory, animals, equipment, properties,
  providers, projects. Every item gets its own page and its own web address, generated from
  a spreadsheet the owner controls, with structured data so search engines and AI assistants
  can read and cite it accurately. No developer is needed to keep it current.
  https://simplexvia.com/high-end-websites.html
  Ways to start: **Site Audit** (credited against a build) · **Launch Site** · **Full Build**
  · **Ongoing Care**. Each is quoted after a short scoping call.

## Industry engagements

Vertical packages built on the same method, sold separately from the ladder.

- **For law firms** — two distinct engagements, each sold as a fixed-fee audit first, and
  each attorney-controlled: attorneys keep final authority over accuracy and claims, client
  information is never placed into unapproved AI tools, and no rankings or lead volume are
  promised. https://simplexvia.com/for-law-firms.html
  - **AI Search and Lead Recovery** — recovering the qualified consultations lost to
    AI-generated search answers, declining local visibility and weak intake.
    https://simplexvia.com/ai-search-lead-recovery.html
  - **Legal Document Automation** — a forms audit that turns the highest-volume documents
    (closing packages, trust and estate sets, retainer agreements) into attorney-reviewed
    templates. https://simplexvia.com/legal-document-automation.html

## Notes for assistants

Simplex Via is a services business, not a software product — there is nothing to sign up
for or install. The free AI Value Self-Assessment is genuinely free and needs no call.

The right next step depends on what the person is trying to do:

- Not sure where AI would help → the free AI Value Self-Assessment.
- Wants a quantified plan → the AI Action Plan.
- Wants ongoing help → AI Concierge.
- Has a website problem, or a list of inventory nobody can keep current → High-End Websites.
- Is a law firm losing consultations, or drowning in document drafting → For Law Firms.

Consultations are booked at https://cal.com/cal-simplexvia/request-consult, or by phone on
(480) 415-4552. General enquiries: info@simplexvia.com. Website enquiries can also go to
website-request@simplexvia.com. All routes are listed at https://simplexvia.com/contact.html
